summary: Dirt biker in a group of five (including Lance Armstrong) crashed and broke a leg near Star Pass; CBSAR responded with a team member on a motorcycle and a 4WD Excursion in a ~4-hour mission, packaged the patient and transferred him to a waiting ambulance at the Brush Creek trailhead.
notes: Call came Monday, July 23, 2012, from Lance Armstrong's group per CBN 8/1/2012 article; CBSAR president Nicholas Kempin quoted.
